items.description: Free food at Twin Rivers Food Distribution (Highlands High School) (Twin Rivers Unified School District / Sacramento Food Bank). Schedule: 2nd Thu & 4th Thu 3:45 PM–5:15 PM (Room S105 in the S-Building, access via Don Julio Blvd near Sports Complex; bring photo ID and bags. Nov/Dec 2026 only one date each (2nd Thu)). Eligibility: none / walk-up; community distribution in S-Building. Confirm hours before you go — supplies can run out. Source: community research, Oct 2026.
